policy: Casual leave is intended for short personal errands. Requests above four consecutive days require HR approval.
Inform your manager on the first day of absence. Medical documentation is required beyond three consecutive days.
Earned leave should be planned with your manager at least two weeks in advance. Carry forward up to 10 days.
Leave without pay may be approved after paid balances are exhausted. Salary is pro-rated for unpaid days.
Supporting documentation is required. Leave must be completed within six months of the event.
Compensatory off must be used within 90 days of being credited and cannot be encashed.
